newsitem.title: USA: NYC's MAC gets at least $40 mln of retail orders.
newsitem.headline: NYC's MAC gets at least $40 mln of retail orders.

text.p: The Municipal Assistance Corp for New York City, which on Monday started selling $579 million of refunding bonds, said it got at least $40 million of retail orders in the first day of the presale period.
"I think it should be in excess of $40 million," said Quentin Spector, executive director, adding that only preliminary information was available so far. The retail order period lasts two days.
To see the retail order period pricing scale, double clik on nN09129734.
